All public evidence gathered. Here is the verified report.

---

**OpenHands/OpenHands #16860 — "feat(skills): replace the all-on skill catalog with an explicit allow-list"** (merged 2026-08-24) — https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/16860

1. **The allow-list change:** reverts the all-59-catalog-skills-on default behind an explicit `enabled_skills` allow-list over the bundled catalog, defaulting to the 11 entries `@openhands/extensions@0.18.0` flags `defaultEnabled` (shipped via OpenHands/extensions#485). `add-javadoc` and `bitbucket*` — #16302's offenders — start off. `undefined` remains the "never migrated" sentinel.
2. **Two implementations:** `src/utils/skill-enablement.ts` is the single decision point — `buildSkillEnablementFilter` (deny-list still vetoes pre-migration), one-shot `migrateSkillEnablement`, and `findInvokedCatalogSkill` so an opening `/command` loads its skill. [`src/api/agent-server-adapter.ts`](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/fae6ad8a0ccaaa5ec8f87aac36abe321e72fbb2c/src/api/agent-server-adapter.ts) filters bundled skills through that rule in `buildAgentContext` and sets `load_public_skills: false`.
3. **Test runner:** Vitest (`npx vitest run`) — 5064 passed per the upstream PR report, one pre-existing unrelated `dev-with-automation` SIGHUP failure that fails identically on untouched `main`. All Vitest, `npm run lint`, and `npm run check-translation-completeness` results (clean; 4 new keys translated for 15 locales) are attributed to the PR report — **I did not run any tests**.
4. **New test files:** [`__tests__/utils/skill-enablement.test.ts`](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/blob/fae6ad8a0ccaaa5ec8f87aac36abe321e72fbb2c/__tests__/utils/skill-enablement.test.ts) (resolver, deny-veto, every migration branch, leading-token invocation) and `__tests__/hooks/use-migrate-enabled-skills.test.tsx` (one-shot, cloud skip, no write over a failed load). The adapter tests now assert `add-javadoc` is *absent* — the flip is the fix.
5. **Remaining uncertainty:** cloud is untouched (own server-side catalog); the agent-profile `disabled_skills` deny-list is a second list the adapter never consults; per-workspace scoping is deferred to phase 3 (needs an SDK `WorkspacesClient` schema change).

Word count: 223. No files were modified.
